note: Final 2.0.0 guide approved with the project owner's explicit waiver of three manual release checks. Those checks remain unperformed, not passed. Publication remains a separate user action.

visualReview.method: Rendered all 67 final pages in Poppler and PDFium. All 66 non-cover page bodies are pixel-identical to the individually reviewed 2.0.0 draft, excluding the footer. Inspected the changed cover and spot-checked pages 2, 26, 57 and 67. Verified every final footer, page number, text boundary, embedded font/image and navigation destination.
visualReview.result: No clipping, overlap, missing images or unreadable instructional close-ups. All 37 images were recaptured from 2.0.0; orientation overviews retain their explanatory captions.

walkthroughEvidence.scope: Core 2.0.0 worked examples passed through real renderer controls with synthetic data. Installer/uninstall walkthroughs are untested and explicitly waived by the owner.

finalVerification.testHarnessFix: Wait for the DM preview animation frame before reading geometry. The first full attempt failed this timing assertion; a complete rerun passed after the fix.

installedTestingCopy.scope: Installed app behavior using isolated synthetic profiles, not an installer or real PDF-reader certification.

customGuidePaths.scope: Copied payload path-resolution checks; no installer execution or PDF viewer certification.

pdfAudit.limits: File inspection and two rendering engines do not establish interactive reader behavior, disconnected Windows use or installation.

priorEditionVerification.scope: User confirmed Firefox opening and tested links for this prior PDF; not counted as full interactive/offline certification of the revised 2.0.0 PDF.
